Warehouse order picker/HLO - Den Hoorn -  €15.29 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the major logistics company Van der Helm? The job is performed using a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is large enough to provide the worker with space to sit and move safely. The machine can reach significant heights, up to 12-16 meters. The worker ascends together with the cabin. Before ascending, the worker places an empty pallet on the forks. Occasionally, there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. When you are high in the air, you pick boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse.
